summary: Full e2e testing of NexusTask (real backend). Backend: 13/13 pytest passing across auth/boards/members/tasks/convert/comments+mentions+notifications/files upload+download/dashboard/role-scoping. Frontend: login flow, dashboard, kanban with 6 columns, task modal (all 5 tabs), comment posting, board-settings modal (all inputs present), Members & roles page (member-role selects present for all 4 users) all functional. One React key collision bug discovered.

ui_bugs.issue: displayStages always appends 'Canceled' (line 17: `[...stages, 'Canceled']`). If board.stages already contains 'Canceled' (e.g. after custom stage config), the Canceled column renders twice, triggering repeated React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, Canceled'. Duplicate data-testid=column-canceled observed. Same duplication risk exists in TaskCard stage <select> at line 147: `[...stages, 'Canceled'].map(...)`.

React 19 hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from linked-cards <select><option> around line 344. Likely from string interpolation instrumentation but worth verifying options only contain plain text.

action_items: Board.jsx: dedupe stages and only append 'Canceled' if not already present. e.g. `const displayStages = stages.includes('Canceled') ? stages : [...stages, 'Canceled'];` (apply same fix at line 147 inside TaskCard).
Optional: verify link-card <option> children are plain strings only to remove hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~870 lines) is close to the 700-line guideline — consider splitting routers (auth, boards, tasks, comments, files, dashboard) into modules.
PATCH /boards allows any board owner/editor to change `stages`; consider guarding against removing a stage that has tasks (currently tasks with removed stage become orphaned in UI).
convert_task only checks direct children for circular parent — deeper cycles (grandchild as parent) not prevented.
seed_admin updates password if it changes but does not similarly refresh demo users' passwords. Acceptable but noted.
Frontend: board.stages state in BoardSettingsModal permits duplicate manual add (guarded via includes) but backend does not enforce uniqueness — recommend dedupe server-side.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded boards 'Product launch' and 'Website refresh'. Any TEST_ boards/tasks created by tests are deleted in teardown. One admin patch was done to reset Product launch stages back to defaults after test-appended 'Canceled'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 backend pytest tests pass against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend paths and data-testids verified: auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, nav-dashboard/mytasks/notifications/members, nav-board-{id}, board-settings-btn, board-settings-modal, new-stage-input, add-stage-btn, save-board-settings, task-modal, task-card-{id}, task-stage-select-{id}, task-stage-select-modal, task-assignee-select, comment-input, comment-submit, member-role-{id}. The only functional bug is duplicate 'Canceled' column when stages already contains it.
rca of the issue: Duplicate React key 'Canceled': Board.jsx unconditionally appends 'Canceled' to the displayed stages regardless of whether the board's stored `stages` already contains it. Reproduction: as super_admin, PATCH /api/boards/{id} with stages that include 'Canceled', then open the board -> two identical 'Canceled' columns render and console warning appears. Fix: guard the append (`stages.includes('Canceled') ? stages : [...stages,'Canceled']`) at Board.jsx line 17 and line 147.
